During the financial year closing, this account is updated<br>by the amount accumulated on the YTD Net Income account. See also YTD Net<br>Income.                                                                                           |
|---------------------------|--------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| revaluation               | The process of revising the value of AP, AR, or GL accounts that are maintained<br>in a foreign currency.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| role                      | A set of access rights to certain system objects—such as specific wiki articles,<br>forms, form elements, and toolbar actions—to which you assign users. When<br>you define roles, give only the access rights necessary to perform typical tasks.<br>Sets of access rights by different roles should not intersect. We recommend<br>that you assign to a user several roles rather than creating a more complicated<br>role with the same privileges as multiple already-defined roles. Acumatica ERP<br>has several preconfigured roles.                                                       |
| S                         |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| sales orders              | A functional area of Acumatica ERP you use to manage sales-related activities,<br>such as maintaining multiple price lists, configuring the system to calculate<br>discounts, entering quotes, fulfilling sales orders, generating pick lists, creat<br>ing shipments, and adding landed costs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| sales price               | A price you set for a particular item that you sell in a specific currency, offer<br>to customers of a particular customer price class, and specify with respect to<br>an appropriate unit of measure. Sales prices can be maintained with regard to<br>items' sales units or base units. See also customer, customer price class, sales<br>unit, and base unit.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| sales unit                | The unit of measure in which a particular item is sold to a customer. See also<br>customer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| schedule                  | A definition in Acumatica ERP of how many times and how often specific AP<br>batches, AR documents should be generated for recurring transactions. Once<br>a batch or a document is assigned to a schedule, its status changes to Sched<br>uled. The system uses the original documents or batches as templates to gen<br>erate similar documents or batches with only transaction dates being changed<br>as dictated by the schedule. See also batch.                                                                                                                                           |
| Search box                | A box that you use to perform a quick search in the entities. You can click the<br>Search icon to open the Search form, which offers more extensive capabilities<br>to search in the system.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| segment                   | 1. In Acumatica ERP, one of the parts of an identifier of an entity—such as<br>account, subaccount, inventory item, subitem, warehouse or location re<br>served to carry special meaning. Segments should be populated with val<br>ues before entities are created. Segment values are alphanumeric strings of<br>the fixed length, and one of the segments may be assigned a numbering se<br>quence. Several input validation options can be used to verify the segment<br>values when users create new entities of the type.<br>2. To break the identifier into segments (as described above). |
|                           | See also account, subaccount, inventory item, location, and warehouse.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |

<span id="page-203-5"></span><span id="page-203-4"></span><span id="page-203-3"></span><span id="page-203-2"></span><span id="page-203-1"></span><span id="page-203-0"></span>

| segmented key        | A system entity that you use to define the structure of identifiers for a certain<br>type of object and then serves as a template when a user creates an identifier<br>for a new object. These segmented keys include the following: ACCOUNT, for<br>GL accounts; SUBACCOUNT, for GL subaccounts; BIZACCT, for vendor and cus<br>tomer accounts; INVENTORY, for inventory items; and SALESPER, for salesper<br>son accounts. For more detailed information, see Segmented Identifiers. See al<br>so general ledger, account, subaccount, and vendor.                                                                                                        |
|----------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| standard cost method | A method for inventory item valuation in which standard cost is calculated<br>outside the system using company-specific policies. With this method, the cur<br>rently effective standard costs are assigned to inventory items on their receipt,<br>issue, adjustment or transfer, regardless of their actual costs. When items as<br>signed to this method are received at the warehouses, any differences be<br>tween the actual and standard costs are recorded to the specified standard<br>cost variance accounts and posted to the general ledger. Standard costs can<br>be updated as often as is needed. See also inventory item and warehouse.     |
| stock item           | An inventory item stored and maintained in steady volumes at some ware<br>house. For each stock item, Acumatica ERP tracks a basic set of item proper<br>ties, such as the item's identifier, description, price, cost, units of measure, and<br>default warehouse and vendor information. Stock items can have many ad<br>ditional properties, known as attributes in Acumatica ERP, that do not affect<br>item processing but may be important for analyzing the stock movements or<br>item sales. See also inventory item and attribute.                                                                                                                 |
| statement cycle      | The schedule for customer statements. You can also set up four aging peri<br>ods that sort open documents by days past due. You can use the aging peri<br>ods to prepare an AR aging schedule at the end of each month, which you can<br>analyze to identify potential cash flow problems. Statement cycles can be as<br>signed to customer classes and to individual customers. See also customer<br>statement, aging period, customer class, and customer.                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| subaccount           | A subcategory of the account that carries identifying information; in Acumat<br>ica ERP, you use subaccounts with accounts to virtually split accounts into<br>smaller, more specific ones. This gives you finer classification within the ac<br>count for reporting and internal management purposes. While account identi<br>fiers carry information about the account type along with the actual account<br>number, subaccount identifiers can provide such information as the division,<br>department, and cost center. Each journal entry is recorded with the appropri<br>ate account and subaccount combination. See also account and journal entry. |
| subitems             | Codes that can be used for further categorization of an inventory items. Su<br>bitems are used in the system if you have otherwise-identical products with<br>different colors, sizes, or other properties tracked because of their importance<br>to customers. Thus, under the same inventory ID, there may be a number of<br>subitems—records about products that share all settings of the inventory item<br>record but have additional properties that differ. If your site uses subitems,<br>they should be specified for each inventory ID related to a stock item. See also<br>inventory item, customer, and stock item.                             |
| T                    |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |

<span id="page-204-5"></span><span id="page-204-4"></span><span id="page-204-3"></span><span id="page-204-2"></span><span id="page-204-1"></span><span id="page-204-0"></span>

| table               | An arrangement of similar objects or details, each displayed with the same<br>number of properties, on many forms. In a details table, each row represents<br>an object or detail (for example, an account, subaccount, document line, or<br>journal entry) and its properties; elements specifying properties are grouped<br>into columns.                                                                                                                                                                     |
|---------------------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| table toolbar       | A toolbar located above (and sometimes above and below) a Details table with<br>buttons you can use to perform detail-related actions, including the follow<br>ing: add, edit, or delete details; filter details; perform custom actions; and re<br>arrange details by changing the order of values in any column.                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| task                | An activity that you have to complete before a due date but that doesn't have<br>a specific time or duration. By default, you create tasks for yourself, but you al<br>so can create tasks and assign them to other employees.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| tax                 | A compulsory financial contribution imposed by a government. In Acumati<br>ca ERP, you can configure taxes of the following major types: Sales, Use, VAT,<br>and Withholding. The definition of each tax includes the tax rate (used to calcu<br>late the tax amount), the method of calculation, the effective date, and the ac<br>counts to which the tax amounts are posted. Each tax is reported to a specific<br>tax agency and is paid to or claimed from the agency. See also account and tax<br>agency. |
| tax agency          | A tax authority, defined in as a vendor, that requires tax reports to be filed reg<br>ularly. For your convenience, you can create a vendor class for tax agencies (lo<br>cal and federal). Each tax agency requires tax reports to be filed regularly. See<br>also vendor and vendor class.                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| tax category        | A list of taxes associated with a product or a service when it is purchased or<br>sold. See also Taxes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| taxes               | A functional area of Acumatica ERP where you can enter the definitions of tax<br>es, tax categories, and tax zones that are used across Acumatica ERP for auto<br>matic tax calculation for every document and transaction. See also Taxes, tax<br>category, and tax zone.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| tax reporting group | An entity used to accrue taxable amounts and tax amounts charged on GL, AP,<br>and AR transactions for tax reporting purposes. For example, a VAT requires<br>two groups (input and output): one for tax amounts charged on sales, and an<br>other for tax amounts charged on purchases. A sales tax requires one output<br>group for taxes on sales. Tax reporting groups are used to calculate the report<br>lines for a report to a tax authority. For more information, see Tax Report                      |
| tax report lines    | Lines configured for a tax agency as a combination of output and input report<br>ing groups for various taxes associated with the same tax agency. See also tax<br>agency and taxes.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| tax zone            | An area or tax jurisdiction where the same taxes are enforced. In Acumatica<br>ERP, a tax zone includes a list of taxes to be applied to a customer's invoice or<br>a vendor's bill depending on the location.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| U                   |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |

<span id="page-205-7"></span><span id="page-205-6"></span><span id="page-205-5"></span><span id="page-205-4"></span><span id="page-205-3"></span><span id="page-205-2"></span><span id="page-205-1"></span><span id="page-205-0"></span>

| user               | A person who uses the ERP system. Once a user has been authenticated, the<br>system checks the user's membership in roles. Users can view only the forms,<br>articles, and elements authorized by their roles, and can perform only the ac<br>tions permitted by these roles. Users may be members of restriction groups,<br>which let them access specific entities included in the groups. See also role,<br>form, and restriction group.                                                                             |
|--------------------|-------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
| V                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| vendor             | One of your company's trade creditors. For ease of use, you can set up de<br>fault values for vendor classes, individual vendors, and vendor documents.<br>When users enter new bills, they must specify a vendor for each bill. Once they<br>choose the vendor, certain elements on the form will be automatically popu<br>lated with the vendor's default values. The due date and available discount are<br>calculated automatically, based on the vendor's credit terms. See also vendor<br>class and credit terms. |
| vendor class       | A group of settings that provides default values when users create new vendor<br>accounts. Divide vendors into classes based on the types of goods they sell or<br>services they provide. See also vendor.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| W                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| warehouse          | A place where goods are stored. A warehouse in Acumatica ERP does not nec<br>essarily represent one physical building where your inventory is stocked; you<br>can divide a large physical storage space into several areas and define each as<br>a warehouse in Acumatica ERP. A warehouse can even be virtual: For example,<br>all goods that are on the way to you from the supplier can be considered as lo<br>cated in the virtual goods-in-transit warehouse.                                                      |
| warehouse location | An actual or virtual place in a warehouse that can be used to receive, store,<br>or issue specific goods or all goods. Each warehouse can include several loca<br>tions. Warehouse location IDs are defined with the INLOCATION segmented key.<br>See also warehouse.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| wiki article       | An entity that consists of digital content on a particular topic and makes up a<br>wiki, along with other articles. Articles can be organized in folders in ways that<br>best fit your needs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| wiki editor        | The form, invoked when you click Edit for an open wiki article, that you use to<br>edit both the article text and its properties.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| wiki markup        | 1. The syntax used to create wiki articles. Using wiki markup, you can create<br>articles, add headings, tables of contents, hint boxes, and warning boxes.<br>2. A mode in which you can edit wiki articles and view the wiki markup.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Wiki toolbar       | A toolbar, appearing below the main menu when you open a wiki article, that<br>provides a variety of actions you can use as you browse the wiki and work with<br>articles. These actions include creating a new article, moving to the previous<br>or next article in the wiki tree, and printing or deleting the current article.                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Y                  |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |

<span id="page-206-0"></span>

| YTD (Year-to-Date) Net In<br>come account | A special account, automatically maintained by the system, that records the<br>net income (the difference between the amounts posted on income and ex<br>pense GL accounts) accumulated since the beginning of the financial year. This<br>difference is updated by every transaction posted. During closing of the finan<br>cial year, the balance of the YTD Net Income account is transferred to the Re<br>tained Earnings account and is reset to zero for a new financial year. The YTD<br>Net Income account should be of the Liability type and must be created before<br>any actual data is entered. See also account and financial year. |
|-------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|                                           |                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
